issue.title: Cycler keep-moving leaf check treats _generated tag pages as ambiguous parents, so sase sub-projects never keep moving in Obsidian

task_type_fields.impact: Every direct sub-project of `sase` (and any project whose parent stem has a generated tag page) is judged a non-leaf by the Obsidian cycler, so Ctrl+Enter / Alt+] closes never open the keep-moving picker there, while Rust `bob capture` (which excludes `_generated/`) does offer them: the two engines disagree on §12.15 K2. Silent today only because those projects' residents are all Blocked; it will misfire as soon as one has Ready work. A planned ledger keep-moving mark that ports this predicate would inherit the bug.
task_type_fields.repro:
## Repro

Node probe through the cycler test harness (no Obsidian needed):

```js
const { helpers } = require("<bob-plugins>/scripts/task-status-cycler-harness.cjs");
// fake app: getMarkdownFiles lists every path; getFirstLinkpathDest resolves `${stem}.md`
const fm = {
  "dev.md": { type: "[[area]]" },
  "sase.md": { type: "[[project]]", parent: "[[dev]]" },
  "sase_pager.md": { type: "[[project]]", parent: "[[sase]]" },
};
helpers.successorLeafProject(app(fm, []), "sase_pager.md");                                    // true
helpers.successorLeafProject(app(fm, ["_generated/tag_pages/topic/sase.md"]), "sase_pager.md"); // false
```

On bob-plugins 66841b1c this printed `true` then `false`. The live vault has had
`_generated/tag_pages/topic/sase.md` in git since 2026-05-30 (also `job.md`, `dev.md`,
`area.md` tag pages). Root cause: `successorKeepMovingResolveParent` counts every
`vault.getMarkdownFiles()` entry with the same stem and returns null when more than one
matches, without excluding the directories Rust and the cycler's own
`PROJECT_PARENT_EXCLUDED_DIRECTORIES` (084-project-parent.js) skip (`_generated`,
`_conflicts`, `_templates`, `.git`, `.obsidian`). Fix: filter the ambiguity scan by that
set, and add an LP vector "parent stem collides with a `_generated/` page → still
resolves" to docs/task-dependencies.md §12.17 and both engines' tests.

issue.creation_reason: Found while researching ledger keep-moving marks: the JS and Rust engines disagree on leafness for every sase sub-project, and the planned mark would inherit the JS bug.

payload.entry: Fixed by epic bob-cli-k7 phase k7.2 (bob-plugins 87b28e1, task-status-cycler 1.49.0): successorKeepMovingResolveParent now ignores files for which projectParentPathIsIndexed is false (_generated, _conflicts, _templates, .git, .obsidian), and §12.17 LP16 plus cycler/Rust/ledger-port LP16 tests cover a _generated/tag_pages/topic/sase.md collision. The k7 land agent re-ran this bead's probe against current bob-plugins: sase_pager.md (parent sase) is a leaf with and without the tag page, both with no marker (no walk) and with a Sub-projects marker (R2 walk through sase). The ⏭ ledger mark ports the fixed predicate (keepMovingMarkLeafProject), so it does not inherit the bug.
